about_short_description.short_description: Great Question is a customer research platform designed to automate research tasks and gain consumer insights.

product.name: Great Question User Research Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that manages the entire UX research process including participant recruitment, scheduling, interviews, surveys, prototype testing, and research repository management.

product.name: Participant Recruitment and Panel Management
product.description: Tools to find, recruit, and manage research participants from internal CRM data or an external panel of over 3 million B2B and B2C candidates.

product.name: Research Scheduling and Calendar Management
product.description: A scheduling system tailored for research that coordinates interviews, focus groups, and continuous discovery sessions with features like candidate waitlists and time proposals.

product.name: Research Repository with AI-Powered Synthesis
product.description: A centralized repository that stores all research data and uses AI to generate summaries, extract insights, themes, and quotes for easy querying and sharing.

product.name: Suite of Research Methodology Tools
product.description: A set of tools supporting various UX research methods such as user interviews, surveys, prototype testing, card sorting, and tree testing.

product.name: Incentive Management
product.description: A feature to send incentives to research participants globally to thank them for their participation in studies.
